notes.title: MudRunner VR - November 7 Patch
notes.content:
Get yer hitches ready, we have a fresh patch incoming for MudRunner VR! In addition to a number of visual and quality-of-life improvements, we also have a truckload of fixes in today’s update. 🚛

If you encounter any issues, please send a ticket to our support team [url=https://support.saber.games]here[/url].


[h2]Resolved Issues[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the lever position on the racing arcade machine
[*] Fixed an issue where the racing arcade machine music would stop playing after going into sleep mode
[*] Fixed an issue with refueling the Scout or Ranger using a fuel can on the gas tank on the left side
[*] Fixed some visual issues that were appearing with some of the vehicles 
[*] Added a collision between the winch and trees to stop the winch cable from going through the trees
[*] Fixed an issue where all coupling points were visible for the Pioneer
[*] Fixed an issue where the cistern refueling door was sometimes inactive 
[*] Addressed an issue where players could climb on top of the trucks
[*] Fixed an issue where it was not always possible to list up abandoned vehicles while in free locomotion mode
[*] Fixed an issue where some of the trucks’ headlights were not working properly
[*] Fixed an issue related to the refueling gun illuminating when you leave the interaction area with said refueling gun
[*] Fixed an issue related to settings not saving when leaving the game
[*] Addressed some errors in the coupling steps happening during Mission 3
[*] Fixed an issue related to refueling the Scout during Mission 4 while in free locomotion mode
[*] Fixed an issue where the Tanker refueling was not always being counted during Mission 7 
[*] Added some additional colliders for rocks in Mission 8
[/list]

Oh hey, by the way, did you know that we feature players’ gameplay clips on our social media channels? [url=https://forms.gle/saJfcxrhhKwsWUH18]Send us your clips[/url] for a chance to have your content featured!

See you out in the woods! 🌲
